name: fernhill-js-charts
description: One chart drawn three ways: D3, Vega-Lite and Observable Plot, rendered in Node with no browser.

scripts.all: node d3_chart.mjs && node vegalite_chart.mjs && node plot_chart.mjs && node hover_test.mjs
scripts.app: tsc --noEmit -p segments_app && esbuild segments_app/main.tsx --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=segments_app/dist/main.js && cp segments_app/index.html segments_app/dist/index.html
